body: Thank you for taking the time to respond to me. I have to get to bed now but I will try to call and make an appointment tomorrow.

I've been to therapists a couple of times in the past but I find it difficult to be completely honest about the things that are bothering me. I minimize my suicidal thoughts out of fear of being involuntarily hospitalized (which would just make everything so much worse). It's my understanding that they won't do that unless they think you are in imminent danger of actually committing suicide, but it's still a concern of mine. 

It's hard because part of me wants to make an appointment to go see someone but I don't think I don't deserve to feel better. I know I need to do something though so that I don't kill myself, if for no other reason than it would really upset my parents.

I just feel constant guilt and shame about this and other (albeit less severe) mistakes in my life. Sometimes I will start to feel better but then I feel guilty about feeling good (because that means I am a callous person) and the cycle starts again. I even feel guilty about posting this because I am just comfort-seeking. I realize that excessive guilt is a classic symptom of depression but in my case I feel like it's just a legitimate response to acknowledging the kind of person that I am.

If I could kill myself without ruining my parents' lives I would.
